'''Al'solib'minet'ri City''' was a small [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galantos]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a party representing the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], led by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], landed there to reconnect Galantos to their communication systems. The city hosted many suites for political guests.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant" />
